Name: VyomSat
Description:
VyomSat - Essence of Space. Built by You.

"Space for Everyone" is a bold tagline, but at VyomSat, we ask a harder question: Is space truly accessible if the engineering behind it remains a "Black Box"? 
Currently, the aerospace education market is split between "toy engineering" kits that oversimplify reality and professional simulators that cost upwards of $12,000. VyomSat occupies the "missing middle." We provide a high-fidelity, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) architecture designed for the next generation of innovators, all for under $200. 

The "Glass Box" Philosophy

We don’t just teach students how to use a satellite; we train them to architect one. Our unique "Glass Box" model ensures that every logic gate, communication protocol, and power distribution decision is completely visible and modifiable. 
Open-Source Excellence: Built on the Raspberry Pi RP2350 and powered by MicroPython, we remove the steep learning curves and financial barriers of traditional aerospace development. 

System-of-Systems Logic: Learners master the critical interdependencies between C&DH, ADCS, EPS, and Communications through our modular 6-Step Integration Framework. 

High-Fidelity Hardware: From 9-axis IMU sensor fusion to autonomous three-state power logic, VyomSat replicates the functional constraints of flight-ready CubeSats and PocketQubes.
 
Our Roadmap to Orbit

We aren't just building a kit; we’re building a pipeline. 

VyomSat Alpha: Our fully open-sourced breadboard prototype for mastering system logic. 

VyomSat Stratos: A ruggedized 3D PCB platform for high-altitude and local field testing. 

VyomSat Orbital: The future of our vision, integrating long-range LoRa for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) readiness. 

The essence of space is no longer a mystery; it is a system of systems, built by you. 

Join the mission and explore our architecture on GitHub:
 https://github.com/OjasJha/vyomsat 

#NewSpace #AerospaceEducation #OpenSourceHardware #STEM #CubeSat #PocketQube

Welcome to the official page for the 47th COSPAR Scientific Assembly (COSPAR 2028), proudly hosted by the Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC).

Scheduled for 8–16 July 2028 at the Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre, this assembly marks a historic milestone as the first COSPAR Scientific Assembly to be held in the Arab world.  

COSPAR 2028 will bring together over 3,000 innovative researchers, experts, and space leaders from around the globe. As the premier forum for international space science, the assembly is dedicated to presenting groundbreaking scientific research, discussing technological advancements, and tackling challenges across all space disciplines.  

Building on the momentum of previous assemblies, COSPAR 2028 will serve as a neutral platform for scientific dialogue, demonstrating the power of international cooperation in shaping the future trajectory of space exploration.

Key Information:

Dates: 8 – 16 July 2028  
Location: Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre, UAE  
Host: Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC)
